publication.title: WoolNet: Finding and Visualising Paths in Knowledge Graphs
publication.version: AMW2024author/proceedings body, indexed2025; publication dates retained separately

source_reading.scope: Identity, introduction, complete indexing/pathfinding/UI/filter sections, performance/usability evaluation and discussion; references not read integrally.

adjudication.basis: WoolNet implements entity-set path discovery with streamed topical subgraphs, autocomplete and length/degree filters over a large actual Wikidata KG. Performance and97-response usability survey are separately reported; path completeness is conjectured, and survey findings lack a controlled comparator.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.design: 100randomsets each of2/3/4/5 nodes,60ssearch budgets from10,000degree-weighted candidate nodes
studies.results: 99,609,308 nodes/715,906,922 edges indexed in4.8h/26.9GB. Degree-expansion bound improves medianfound edges/min from24–194to34–1,009and reduces median query memory from7GBto100MB.
limitations: Workload/path discovery rate is not arbitrary-query latency guarantee; heuristics alter explored paths.

studies.cohort_note: Authors report97 respondents; cross-language deduplication not documented.
studies.design: Online single-system SUS after guided and self-chosen search tasks
limitations: Convenience communities/language conditions not randomized; no interface comparator; task/result accuracy not validated. Two tasks/language subgroups are not new cohorts.

descriptions.interaction: Select two or more entities with autocomplete; stream connecting paths into a force-directed graph; click intermediate nodes to highlight their paths; drag nodes and filter path length or intermediate degree.
descriptions.guidance: ["Entity autocomplete", "Explanatory connecting subgraphs", "Progressive path arrivals and selected-node highlighting"]
descriptions.visualisation: ["Directed labelled node-link topical graph", "Entity labels/images", "Numeric pathfilter sliders"]
descriptions.backend: Wikidata truthy labelled triples encoded in a custom three-dimensional integer adjacency index.
